inputs.name: projectFiles.input
inputs.description: `ProjectTemplateInput` supplies the project name and kind used to plan scaffold files. `kind` is `app`, `lib`, or `game`; optional `dimension` is `2d` or `3d` and is passed to game scaffolding only when `kind` is `game`.

outputs.name: projectFiles
outputs.description: The result is the planned file list for the selected project scaffold; source-created entries have a repository-relative `path` and `contents`. The file set depends on `kind`: libraries follow a separate branch, while apps and games start from the app scaffold.

examples.contents:
# inventory-app

A Harness SvelteKit app with small files, specs, tests, and adapters.
